name: week
title: Psychology practice week
subtitle: Read-only administration. Fictional data when seeded.

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by kind,client

sections.title: Next seven days
sections.sql: select client,practitioner,starts_at,status from v_diary where starts_at>=current_date and starts_at<current_date+7 order by starts_at

sections.title: Referral courses
sections.sql: select name,client,funder,remaining from v_referrals where not closed order by remaining

sections.title: Outstanding by currency
sections.sql: select name,client,payer,currency,balance_cents,days_overdue from v_debtors where balance_cents>0 order by days_overdue desc
